_note: Diagnostic codes this build is allowed to emit. `pnpm run check` fails when the build produces a
code that is not listed here, so a new silent degradation becomes a red check with a one-line diff
to review instead of a WARN nobody reads. When a degradation is understood and accepted, add its
code here in the same commit; when it is fixed, remove it — a listed code that no longer occurs is
reported too, so the baseline cannot quietly rot.
